      How the rank is earned
      • Ladder position is worth the most.
      • Personal records above your week-1 baseline add on top.
      • Following the plan adds the rest.
      • Strength only sets your ceiling.
      • Every completely empty week costs rank.

      Rank-exclusive designs

      Pure cosmetics — they change how your figures look, never how the numbers are earned.

      Three rules for skill work
      • Train it fresh, right after the warm-up, before anything else.
      • Stop well short of failure. Skills are coordination, and tired practice builds a sloppy pattern.
      • Ten minutes four or five times a week beats an hour once.

      Find your starting point

      Four tests, twenty minutes. Warm up first, rest three minutes between each, and stop the moment your form breaks. Your lowest score is your level.

      Day one measures you in automatically — first contact with an exercise runs three max sets inside the session. This page is for the week 6 and week 12 retests.
